title: Greeting with Variables
hints: Integer.parseInt(IO.readln().trim()) reads the next line and turns it into an int.
Use + to join text and variables: "Hello, " + name + "!"
Careful: "be " + age + 1 gives "be 361". Put the math in parentheses: (age + 1).

mustContain.message: Store the age in an int variable.

tests.output:
Hello, Ada!
Next year you will be 37 years old.

Hello, Linus!
Next year you will be 21 years old.

Hello, Grace!
Next year you will be 1 years old.

Hello, Alan!
Next year you will be 100 years old.
